annotations.title: Simulate Webhook Replay & Out-of-Order State Machine

description: Deterministically evaluate an ordered or out-of-order sequence of 1-10 Stripe/Shopify/RevClamp subscription lifecycle webhooks against a 72-hour idempotency deduplication Set (eventId), a configurable idempotencyWindowSec (60s-2592000s, default: 259200s / 72h), and a monotonic transition timestamp guard (event.createdSec >= lastAppliedCreatedSec). Compares RevClamp's monotonic FSM against a naive overwrite-on-arrival handler to detect resurrected canceled subscriptions, stale tier downgrades, and duplicate retry side-effects. Returns structuredContent containing ok, mode, statelessEphemeralAudit, tenantId, simulation, steps, finalStatus, finalTier, finalEntitlementDecision, naiveFinalStatus, and naiveHandlerBug.

demo.description: Optional sandbox flag to run the preset replay simulation.

events.description: Optional custom array of 1 to 10 webhook events ({ eventId, eventType, createdSec, subscriptionStatus, tier, currentPeriodEndSec }) in arrival order.

arrivedAtSec.description: Optional arrival timestamp in Unix seconds for per-event deduplication window evaluation.

created.description: Alias for createdSec when passing Stripe Unix created timestamps.

createdSec.description: Provider event creation timestamp in Unix seconds (must be <= nowSec + 34560000 / 400 days) compared monotonically against lastAppliedCreatedSec.

currentPeriodEndSec.description: Optional subscription current_period_end timestamp in Unix seconds.

eventId.description: Unique provider webhook event ID (e.g. evt_cancel_final_1050) checked against the 72-hour deduplication Set.

eventType.description: Webhook event type string (e.g. customer.subscription.deleted, customer.subscription.updated, invoice.payment_failed).

id.description: Alias for eventId when passing raw Stripe/Shopify event objects.

subscriptionStatus.description: Subscription lifecycle status carried by this webhook event.

tier.description: Optional RevClamp plan tier associated with the subscription state (default: 'growth_59').

type.description: Alias for eventType (defaults to 'customer.subscription.updated' when omitted).

idempotencyWindowSec.description: Deduplication and replay-acceptance window in seconds (valid range: 60 to 2592000, default: 259200 for 72 hours).

nowSec.description: Reference evaluation timestamp in Unix seconds used to check the 72-hour idempotency window.

scenarioPreset.description: Scenario preset to evaluate when custom events are omitted (default: 'out_of_order_stale_update_after_cancel').

name: revclamp_simulate_webhook_replay
